contents.text: How much did Microsoft's research and development expenses increase in fiscal 2026 compared to fiscal 2025, in dollars?

Microsoft's research and development expenses increased $3.1 billion or 9% in fiscal 2026 compared to fiscal 2025. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 7. MANAGEMENT’S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS)
